entities.summary: Hong Sa-ik, also known by the Japanese reading of his name Kō Shiyoku , was a lieutenant general in the Imperial Japanese Army and the top-ranking ethnic Korean in Japan to be charged with war crimes relating to the conduct of the Empire of Japan in World War II.
